headline: Storm arrives tomorrow — harvest onions and potatoes today.
weather_notes: Skip all irrigation through Friday — Thursday's 90% storm is forecast to deliver 0.25–0.5 in, fully resetting bed moisture; watering today would be wasted.
Complete all harvest work by midday today — today's 89°F is the last clear outdoor window before Thursday's rain saturates soil through Friday.
Shade e1–e4 tomato beds through 11 AM — 89°F today with incoming storm humidity sustains sunscald risk before Phoenix's Aug 24 harvest window opens.
Pick ripe blackberries before Wednesday evening — Thursday's 90% storm will knock ripe Triple Crown fruit from canes before you can harvest.
